pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Anuruddho Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena tasmiṃ gāme aññatarissā itthiyā āvasathāgāraṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.4: atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho yena sā itthi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etad avoca: sace te bhagini agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.6: aññe pi addhikā yena sā itthi ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etad avocuṃ: sace te ayye agaru vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.7: eso kho ayyo samaṇo paṭhamaṃ upagato, sace so anujānāti, vaseyyāthā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.8: atha kho te addhikā yenāyasmā Anuruddho ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avocuṃ: sace te bhante agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.10: atha kho sā itthi āyasmante Anuruddhe saha dassanena paṭibaddhacittā ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.11: atha kho sā itthi yenāyasmā Anuruddho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca: ayyo bhante imehi manussehi ākiṇṇo na phāsu viharissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.12: sādh' āhaṃ bhante ayyassa mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññāpeyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.14: atha kho sā itthi āyasmato Anuruddhassa mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññāpetvā alaṃkatapaṭiyattā gandhagandhinī yenāyasmā Anuruddho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.15: ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko ahañ ca 'mhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.16: sādh' āhaṃ bhante ayyassa pajāpati bhaveyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.17: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Anuruddho tuṇhi ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.19: tatiyam pi kho sā itthi āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.20: ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko ahañ ca 'mhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.21: sādhu bhante ayyo mañ c' eva paṭicchatu sabbañ ca sāpateyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.22: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Anuruddho tuṇhi ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.23: atha kho sā itthi sāṭakaṃ nikkhipitvā āyasmato Anuruddhassa purato caṅkamati pi tiṭṭhati pi nisīdati pi seyyaṃ pi kappeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.24: atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho indriyāni okkhipitvā taṃ itthiṃ n' eva olokesi na pi ālapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.25: atha kho sā itthi acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.26: bahū me manussā satena pi sahassena pi pahiṇanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.27: ayaṃ pana samaṇo mayā sāmaṃ yāciyamāno na icchati mañ c' eva paṭicchituṃ sabbañ ca sāpateyyan ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.28: sāṭakaṃ nivāsetvā āyasmato Anuruddhassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.29: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yāhaṃ evam akāsiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.30: tassā me bhante ayyo accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhatu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.31: taggha taṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ, yā tvaṃ evam akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.32: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.33: vuddhi h' esā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ ca saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.34: atha kho sā itthi tassā rattiyā accayena āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.35: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ itthiṃ āyasmā Anuruddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.36: atha kho sā itthi āyasmatā Anuruddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.38: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.39: eva ayyena Anuruddhena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.40: esāhaṃ bhante taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.41: upāsikaṃ maṃ ayyo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.42: atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.43: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.44: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Anuruddho mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.45: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.46: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Anuruddha mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.48: vigarahi buddho bhagavā: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ Anuruddha mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.49: n' etaṃ Anuruddha appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.50: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.51.1: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.6: manussitthi na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā antamaso tadahujātāpi dārikā pag eva mahattarī.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.10: sabbacchannā sabbaparicchannā yebhuyyena cchannā yebhuyyena paricchannā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.13: mātugāme nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.14: bhikkhu nipanne mātugāmo nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.2: mātugāme vematiko s. k., āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.3: mātugāme amātugāmasaññī s. k., āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.5: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatitthiyā vā s. k., āpatti dukkaṭassa.
